messages.content: You are Nemotron-3-Super, the Plan Completer & Co-Reviewer in a multi-agent pipeline. You receive a Lead GLM-5.2 draft implementation plan plus current source context. Your job: complete/refine the plan — optimize control flow, patch edge cases, harden data/state paths, catch integration drift, and verify it satisfies the user's actual request. Return ONLY a refined blueprint as structured markdown: (1) Confirmed approach, (2) Edge cases / risks found, (3) File-by-file change spec with exact signatures, (4) Interface contract lock (Alpine factory name, state, methods, event-bus source id, data shape), (5) Verification steps. Be concise and concrete. Do not write the final code — only the blueprint.

USER REQUEST: Merge the landing-page 'Insights' tab INTO the 'Workflow' tab. Each of the 4 workflow stage cards must carry its own audio / video / text-modal affordances on the SAME card (compact, not a separate tab). Add an auto-rotating text strip at the bottom of the workflow page (auto-rotate tips). Remove the standalone Insights tab. Result must be compact, elegant, ERP-grade, Filament-native, using existing --custom-*/--google-* tokens and .lp-* primitives (NO glass/3D). Validate via MiniMax-M3.

=== LEAD GLM-5.2 DRAFT BLUEPRINT ===

CONTEXT: BMS-CM landing page has 4 tabs: Customize / Workflow / Search / Insights. Workflow tab = horizontal 4-stage stepper (numbered cards w/ title+description+2 link rows+count pills, connector chevrons). Insights tab = separate; a rotating hero (poster+tip+Listen/Watch/Shuffle) + 4-card grid + text-modal(terms/process/dos/donts) + video-modal. The data provider LandingPage.php::getInsightGroups() returns exactly 4 groups keyed 1:1 with the 4 workflow stages: request_approval->blue (stage1), order_processing->green (stage2), procurement_payment->yellow (stage3), logistics->red (stage4). Each group shape: {key,title,scopeLabel,accent,tips[],terms[],process[],dos[],donts[],poster,audio,video,route}. tips is non-empty for all 4 (gate passed). The workflow $steps array in workflow.blade.php is the same 4 stages in the same order. So merge is a natural 1:1 join.

PROPOSED CHANGES:
1. LandingPage.php — NO change. getInsightGroups() already returns the 4 groups; already merged into getViewData() as $insightGroups, available to all includes.
2. workflow.blade.php — rewrite: wrap root in x-data="workflow(@js($insightGroups))"; build $insightByGroup=collect($insightGroups??[])->keyBy('key'); add 'group'=>'request_approval'|'order_processing'|'procurement_payment'|'logistics' to each $step; each stage card keeps number badge+title+description+link rows+counts AND gains a compact media affordance row: Listen(audio) / Watch(video) / Read(text) icon buttons, each x-show-gated on that insight's media presence; Read opens text-modal; Watch opens video-modal; Listen plays audio inline (no modal). Move text-modal + video-modal markup (from insights.blade.php) into this file. Add auto-rotate ticker at bottom (above footer) cycling flattened tips every 7s w/ source-stage accent dot + title, x-transition crossfade, pause on hover, click opens that stage text-modal. Footer stays below ticker.
3. insights.blade.php — DELETE (content merged into workflow).
4. header.blade.php — remove the Insights tab button (the @if(!empty($insightGroups)) block).
5. landing-page.blade.php — remove the activeTab==='insights' panel div.
6. Rename resources/js/insights-alpine.js -> resources/js/workflow-alpine.js, factory workflow(groups). State: groups, flatten all tips into tips[] each {tip,accent,title,key,route}; rotateIdx; playing; audio; selected; textOpen; videoOpen; paused; rotateInterval. init(): lp-audio-play listener (pause self when e.detail.source!=='workflow' && playing); start rotateInterval 7s advancing rotateIdx, skip when textOpen||videoOpen||playing||paused||tips.length<2. destroy(): clearInterval. Methods: openText(group), openVideo(group), playPause(group), stopAudio(), nextTip(), togglePause(). get currentTip. Keep lp-audio-play event bus, dispatch {source:'workflow'} (was 'insights'). triWidget side unchanged (listens source!=='widget').
7. alpine-loader.js — rename import insights->workflow, guard [x-data^="workflow("] prefix-match, Alpine.data('workflow',workflow).
8. landing-page.css — add .lp-ticker primitives (flat bordered bar, accent dot, source label) using existing --custom-*/lp-* tokens; NO new keyframes (use Alpine x-transition for crossfade + CSS transition for a thin progress bar). Avoid reintroducing removed classes.
9. Lang: fr missing insights_watch + insights_open_module — add them; add new key workflow_read (Read/مطالعه/Lire) and insights_tip_prefix (e.g. 'Tip'/'نکته'/'Astuce') to all 3 locales.

INTERFACE CONTRACT LOCK (proposed): Alpine factory name 'workflow', default-export from resources/js/workflow-alpine.js, signature workflow(groups)->plain object. Root attribute x-data="workflow(@js($insightGroups))". Public state: selected,textOpen,videoOpen,playing,rotateIdx,paused. Public methods: openText(group),openVideo(group),playPause(group),stopAudio(),nextTip(),togglePause(). Event bus: lp-audio-play with detail.source='workflow'. Group data shape unchanged from PHP.

Verify: npm run build green; grep confirms zero remaining 'insights' references in blade/loader (except lang keys which stay); fr locale resolves all keys.

Refine this blueprint. Specifically pressure-test: (a) the 1:1 stage<->group join correctness and what happens if a group is absent for a stage; (b) the lp-audio-play source-id rename interaction with triWidget; (c) the auto-rotate pause semantics; (d) whether deleting insights.blade.php + removing the tab leaves any dangling reference; (e) compact card layout that holds 2 link rows + 3 media buttons without overflow at the lp-surface width; (f) any token/CSS drift.
